title: Cosmic Robot and Jellyfish
description: A metallic steampunk robot with glowing blue eyes stands on a stone pedestal inscribed with text, its four mechanical arms connected to swirling galaxy orbs. Above it, a large purple jellyfish with embedded beetles floats over three overlapping female profile faces in pink, blue, and orange, set against a starry cosmic background with sparkles and dark earthy base elements.
